question: The 2021, U-19 Asia Cup Cricket was hosted by which of the following countries?
solution:
The Correct Answer is** UAE.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **2021 Under-19 Asia Cup **was the 9th edition of ACC Under-19 Cup.
 
• The cricket tournament was played in **United Arab Emirates** from 23 December 2021 to 31 December 2021. 
 
• The tournament provides a platform for young cricketers from Asian countries to showcase their talents and gain valuable international experience.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Here are the key points about the 2023 ACC Under-19 Asia Cup:**
 
• **Date and Venue: **The tournament was held from December 8 to December 17, 2023, in Dubai, UAE.
 
• **Teams:** Eight teams participated, divided into two groups.
 
 
• Group A included India, Pakistan, Afghanistan, and Nepal.
 
• Group B consisted of Bangladesh, UAE, Japan, and Sri Lanka.
 
 
 
• **Format:** The tournament format was a round-robin within each group, with the top two teams from each group advancing to the semi-finals.
 
• **Defending Champions:** India U19 entered the tournament as the defending champions, having a strong historical record with eight victories in past editions of the tournament.
 
• **Venues: **Matches were played across three venues in Dubai-ACC Academy Ground, ICC Academy Ground No 2, and Dubai International Cricket Stadium.
 
• **Live Streaming: **The matches were available for live streaming on the Asian Cricket Council's YouTube channel.
 
• **Final Match:** The summit clash took place on December 17th at the Dubai International Cricket Stadium.
